evals.prompt: I just got a new Mac. Set up the golems ecosystem from scratch.
evals.expected_output: Checks all required CLI dependencies (gh, op, bun, cr, git, jq, fswatch). Installs missing ones via brew/curl. Creates skill symlinks. Wires MCP servers. Verifies 1Password access. Installs into ~/.claude/skills/ ONLY — never ~/.claude/commands/ — and clears any legacy golem-powers entry already there.

assertions.name: verifies-deps-before-install
assertions.description: Checks which CLIs are installed (gh, op, bun, cr, git, jq, fswatch) before attempting to install missing ones

assertions.name: creates-skill-symlinks
assertions.description: Symlinks skills from ~/Gits/golems/skills/golem-powers/ into ~/.claude/skills/ and verifies count (40+)

assertions.name: wires-mcp-servers
assertions.description: Checks for brainlayer-mcp and voicelayer-mcp binaries and provides bun link instructions if missing

assertions.name: runs-validation-checklist
assertions.description: Runs the validation checklist at the end to confirm CLIs, skills count, and MCP binaries are all working

assertions.name: never-writes-claude-commands
assertions.description: Creates NO symlink, directory or file under ~/.claude/commands/<skill>. Claude Code walks commands/**/*.md recursively, so a skill there lists every workflows/, references/ and evals/fixtures/ file as its own 'skill'. ~/.claude/skills/ is the only install target.

evals.prompt: My Claude skills aren't showing up. I think something went wrong with the setup.
evals.expected_output: Checks ~/.claude/skills/ for existing symlinks. Re-runs the symlink creation step from golem-powers. Verifies the skill count is 40+. Also clears legacy ~/.claude/commands/ entries in all three shapes (symlink into golems, symlink into ~/.claude/skills/<name>, real mkdir'd directory) and removes dead symlinks from ~/.claude/skills/.

assertions.name: checks-existing-symlinks
assertions.description: Lists ~/.claude/skills/ to see current state before re-creating symlinks

assertions.name: verifies-skill-count
assertions.description: Counts linked skills and verifies there are 40+ (not just 'done' without checking)

assertions.name: removes-legacy-commands-entries
assertions.description: Deletes every leftover golem-powers entry under ~/.claude/commands/, covering all three shapes: a symlink into $GOLEMS_DIR/skills/golem-powers/<name>, the golems-cli backfill symlink into ~/.claude/skills/<name>, and a REAL directory from an old `mkdir -p ~/.claude/commands/<name>` (rm -f cannot remove that one — it is migrated to skills/ or reported). Does not touch non-golems entries.

assertions.name: asserts-invariant-after-fix
assertions.description: Re-checks after fixing — `validate.sh --skills-only` or `cleanup-legacy-commands.sh --check` must exit 0. A grep of `ls -l ~/.claude/commands` for 'skills/golem-powers' is NOT sufficient: it misses the backfill shape whose target is ~/.claude/skills/<name>.

evals.prompt: I need to verify my golem setup is correct. Run the full validation.
evals.expected_output: Runs the validation checklist: checks all 7 CLIs (gh, op, bun, cr, git, jq, fswatch), counts skills in ~/.claude/skills/, checks brainlayer-mcp and voicelayer-mcp binaries.

assertions.name: checks-all-seven-clis
assertions.description: Checks all required CLIs: gh, op, bun, cr, git, jq, fswatch (not a subset)

assertions.name: checks-mcp-binaries
assertions.description: Verifies brainlayer-mcp and voicelayer-mcp are in PATH

assertions.name: reports-specific-failures
assertions.description: Reports which specific items passed/failed with clear indicators, not just a blanket pass/fail
